meta.name: email
meta.description: Send emails via Resend, Mailgun, or SendGrid using your own API credentials. Auto-detects available provider. Use for reports, alerts, client communications, and business emails.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动发送业务邮件与通知
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里自动发出邮件
copy.tagline_en: Send business emails and alerts automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically send emails from your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用你在环境变量里配置的邮箱服务商(Resend、Mailgun 或 SendGrid)发送邮件。它自动选用已配置密钥的服务商,支持纯文本/HTML、多个收件人和抄送,还能按模板发报告、警报等。
howto.when: 当你要求给某人发邮件,并且至少一家服务商(Resend、Mailgun 或 SendGrid)的密钥已配置在环境中时触发,常用于报告、警报、客户沟通等。

say.text: 帮我用 Resend 给张三发一封纯文本邮件,内容是项目进度。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Resend 发送纯文本邮件。

say.text: 给这三个邮箱群发一封 HTML 周报,标题是本周摘要。
say.note: Claude 会向多个收件人发送 HTML 邮件。

say.text: 用 Mailgun 给李四发送一封警报邮件,服务名是支付系统。
say.note: Claude 会用 Mailgun 发出警报邮件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can send emails using your own Resend, Mailgun, or SendGrid credentials. It auto-detects the provider with configured keys, supports plain-text/HTML, multiple recipients/CC, and template-based reports and alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to send an email and at least one provider key (Resend, Mailgun, or SendGrid) is configured. Used for reports, alerts, client communications, and business emails.

say_en.text: Send a plain-text email to John via Resend with the project update.
say_en.note: Claude calls the Resend API to send plain text.

say_en.text: Send an HTML weekly summary to these three addresses.
say_en.note: Claude sends HTML email to multiple recipients.

say_en.text: Send an alert email via Mailgun to Li about the payment service.
say_en.note: Claude uses Mailgun to deliver the alert.
